# A Skull breaks on any ceiling it hits going up (851-3473, docs/quirks.md §1), and the wiki clip
# quirks/skull-breaks-on-ceiling. A staged scene (written by wiki-clips --replays from a scene spec,
# docs/wiki-media.md): it boots, loads this custom level from the title's load-level menu (240), and plays the
# scene's inputs from 241, its frame 0. The player (@) has a Jar (j) on his left and a Skull (k, with its
# bones) two tiles to his right, under a ceiling four tiles above the floor:

# He picks up the Jar (259) and throws it up and to the left (271, yVel -9). It reaches the ceiling still
# rising, at 3 px a step, -2.4 after gravity (282): oJar's step breaks it on a ceiling only if yVel < -3, so it
# bounces off whole, and breaks only when it lands from that height (296, yVel > 3). Then he picks up the Skull
# (335) and throws it up and to the right the same way. It reaches the ceiling rising slower still, at 2.4 px a
# step, -1.8 after gravity (359), and breaks there: oSkull's copy of the check reads if (yVel < 2), inside
# if (colTop and yVel < 0), so any upward hit breaks it.
# story: held=oJar@259..259 oJar.yVel>0@282..282 !-oJar@..295 -oJar@296..296 held=oSkull@335..335
# story: oSkull.yVel>-3@358..358 -oSkull@359..359 +oBone@359..359
